verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a SaaS control-plane product, so asking whether its APIs are versioned and covered by a deprecation policy is fair. The evidence pack never mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy. The only API-adjacent items are automation via IaC and webhooks, and API keys expiring after 60 days, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
